reviews.review_title: Review at Pizza 4P's Hai Ba Trung
reviews.review_text:
Anh Amắn 🇻🇳
Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam12939 contributions
17
Delicious Pizza in HCM
Dec 2024 • Friends
I came for dinner here with a good friend last night. We had booked and luckily so, when we arrived there was huge queue . Due to booking, we only needed to wait 5 minutes while they prepared our table and we jumped ahead of the queue.

This particular 4Ps is huge, over two levels and it was packed totally on a Thursday night. Testimony to how popular they have become. They are definitely the best Pizza restaurant chain in Vietnam. Their salads and pasta dishes are good too. Definitely try the spaghetti with crab if you get a chance, simply delicious.

Service is pretty good, ordering is by scanning a QR code to bring up the menu on your smart phone and ordering directly. Considering how crowded they were last night, the wait was totally reasonable and not long, the food was delicious.

For tourists, please note: it is not easy to find at first. There is only a small sign for Pizza 4P at the top of the laneway. The laneway has a Japanese Sake Pub at the corner. Walk down the laneway, past all the parked bikes till you get to the end and to your left is the entrance… you can’t miss it when you walk down to the end of the laneway.
